- **Daguerreotype** (`lumenary:daguerreotype`, models this process): A daguerreotype is an image on a silver plate polished like a mirror. Tilt it one way and the plate reflects something dark, so the picture looks like a positive. Tilt it the other way and it reflects something bright and seems to turn into a negative. Tarnish… Model: `processes/models/lumenary/daguerreotype.json`; theory: `treatments/lumenary/theory/08-optical.md`.
